description: This file defines the main page component of a Notes application frontend built with React and Next.js. It manages authentication, note listing, creating, editing, and deleting notes, and handles UI layout including header, sidebar, and editor components.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the API based on the current query; updates notes state and active note accordingly.

methods.name: handleNewNote
methods.description: Creates a new untitled note and sets it as active.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current note, either updating existing or creating a new one, and updates notes state.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the active note and updates the notes list and active note.
